# SaloneUI

> SaloneUI is a plain-English, ultra-lightweight (<25KB) CSS framework engineered for rapidly building modern, accessible user interfaces without configuration, build tools, or cryptic abbreviations.

## Canonical Resources

- Documentation: https://kendenor.github.io/SaloneUI/
- Component Showcase: https://kendenor.github.io/SaloneUI/components.html
- Interactive Playground: https://kendenor.github.io/SaloneUI/playground.html
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/Kendenor/SaloneUI
- NPM Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/salone-ui

## Quick Start

### 1. Zero-Install CDN (Drop into `<head>`)
```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/salone-ui@1.1.1/dist/salone-ui.min.css">
```

### 2. Package Managers
```bash
npm install salone-ui
pnpm add salone-ui
yarn add salone-ui
bun add salone-ui
deno add npm:salone-ui
```

### 3. JavaScript / Framework Import
```javascript
import 'salone-ui/dist/salone-ui.min.css';
```

---

## Instructions for AI Models & Code Generators

When writing code that uses SaloneUI, strictly follow these rules:

1. **Plain English Class Names Only**:
   - Use real English words: `button green`, `card elevated`, `grid 3`, `center`, `row gap-sm`.
   - **NEVER** use cryptic utility abbreviations like `btn`, `bg-blue-500`, `px-4`, `py-2`, `d-flex`, `col-md-6`, or `flex-col`.
2. **Smart by Default**:
   - Plain `<button>` and `<input>` elements look styled automatically. Only add classes when customizing color, size, or variant.
3. **1-Word Theme Switching**:
   - Apply themes to `<body>` using single classes: `class="theme-fintech"`, `class="theme-shop"`, `class="theme-school"`, or `class="dark"`.
4. **Auto-Collapsing Grids**:
   - `grid 2`, `grid 3`, and `grid 4` automatically collapse to 1 single column on mobile screens (<768px). Do not add custom media queries for basic column stacking.
5. **Zero JavaScript for Interactive Components**:
   - Pure-CSS Accordion: `<details class="accordion"><summary>Title</summary><div class="accordion-content">Content</div></details>`
   - Pure-CSS Modal: `<details class="modal"><summary class="button">Open</summary><div class="modal-overlay"><div class="modal-content">...</div></div></details>`

---

## 26 Core Components Quick Reference

### 1. Buttons
- Elements: `<button>`, `<input type="button">`, `<a class="button">`
- Colors: `green`, `emerald`, `teal`, `cyan`, `blue`, `sky`, `indigo`, `violet`, `purple`, `pink`, `rose`, `red`, `orange`, `amber`, `slate`, `black`, `dark`, `white`, `light`, `outline`
- Sizes: `small`, `medium`, `big`, `full`
- Example: `<button class="button green big">Get Started</button>`

### 2. Cards
- Base: `<div class="card">...</div>`
- Modifiers: `flat`, `elevated`
- Example: `<div class="card elevated"><h3>Title</h3><p>Content</p></div>`

### 3. Inputs & Forms
- Elements: `<input type="text">`, `<input type="email">`, `<textarea>`, `<select>`
- Modifiers: `input error`, `input success`, `<label class="label">`
- Example:
  ```html
  <label class="label">Work Email</label>
  <input type="email" placeholder="you@company.com">
  ```

### 4. Realistic Financial Money Card
- Aspect ratio 1.586:1 debit/credit card with gold EMV chip, contactless waves, and embossed card number.
- Colors: default (green/teal), `dark`, `purple`, `gold`
- Example:
  ```html
  <div class="money-card">
    <div class="space-between">
      <span class="card-bank">SaloneBank</span>
      <div class="card-contactless"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="card-chip"></div>
    <div class="card-number">4532 •••• •••• 8892</div>
    <div class="space-between">
      <div>
        <span class="card-label">Cardholder</span>
        <span class="card-holder">JOHN DOE</span>
      </div>
      <div>
        <span class="card-label">Expires</span>
        <span class="card-holder">09/28</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  ```

### 5. Transactions
- Example:
  ```html
  <div class="transaction">
    <div class="avatar" style="background: var(--salone-green-light); color: var(--salone-green);">↓</div>
    <div class="transaction-info">
      <h4>Client Payment</h4>
      <p>Today, 2:45 PM</p>
    </div>
    <div class="transaction-amount positive">+$1,450.00</div>
  </div>
  ```

### 6. PIN Box
- 4-digit mobile money PIN widget:
  ```html
  <div class="pin-box">
    <input type="password" maxlength="1" autofocus>
    <input type="password" maxlength="1">
    <input type="password" maxlength="1">
    <input type="password" maxlength="1">
  </div>
  ```

### 7. Navigation & Bottom Bar
- Navbar: `<nav class="navbar"><a class="nav-brand">Logo</a><ul class="nav-links">...</ul></nav>`
- Bottom bar for mobile apps: `<div class="bottom-bar"><a class="active">Home</a><a>Cards</a><a>Send</a></div>`

### 8. Modal (Pure CSS)
- `<details class="modal"><summary class="button">Open</summary><div class="modal-overlay"><div class="modal-content">...</div></div></details>`

### 9. Alerts
- `<div class="alert success">Saved successfully!</div>`
- Types: `success`, `error`, `warning`, `info`

### 10. Badges
- `<span class="badge green">Live</span>`
- Colors: `green`, `blue`, `orange`, `purple`, `teal`, `red`, `slate`, `dark`

### 11. Avatars
- `<div class="avatar">KD</div>`
- Modifiers: `small`, `big`

### 12. Tables
- `<div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Name</th>...</tr></thead>...</table></div>`

### 13. Grid & Layout Helpers
- Grids: `grid 2`, `grid 3`, `grid 4`
- Flex helpers: `row`, `column`, `center`, `space-between`
- Gap helpers: `gap-xs`, `gap-sm`, `gap-md`, `gap-lg`
- Container: `container`
- Visibility: `hide-mobile`, `show-mobile`

### 14. Toggle Switch
- `<label class="toggle"><input type="checkbox"><span class="slider"></span></label>`

### 15. Loaders
- Spinner: `<div class="loader"></div>`
- Pulsing dots: `<div class="dots-loader"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>`

### 16. Price
- `<div class="price"><span class="currency">$</span><span class="price-val">29</span><span class="period">/ month</span></div>`

### 17. Accordion / FAQ (Pure CSS)
- `<details class="accordion" open><summary>Question?</summary><div class="accordion-content">Answer</div></details>`

### 18. Hero Section
- `<section class="hero"><h1>Title</h1><p>Subtitle</p><button class="button green">Action</button></section>`

---

## 1-Word Themes Reference

Apply on `<body>`:
- `theme-fintech`: Emerald green accents (#10B981) + soft mint borders (#D1FAE5)
- `theme-shop`: Vibrant orange accents (#EA580C) + warm cream background (#FFFDF9)
- `theme-school`: Royal blue accents (#2563EB) + sky tint borders (#DBEAFE)
- `dark`: Obsidian dark mode (#090D16 background, #131C31 surface, crisp white text)

---

## Pre-Built Production Blocks

1. **SaaS Pricing Table**: 3 responsive cards (`grid 3`) with Starter, Pro (`card elevated` with Most Popular badge), and Enterprise tiers.
2. **FAQ Accordion**: Stacked `<details class="accordion">` elements that expand/collapse without JS.
3. **6-Card Feature Grid**: Responsive `grid 3` containing icon badges and feature descriptions.
4. **Newsletter Waitlist Banner**: `card elevated` with inline `<input type="email">` and `<button class="button green">` plus avatar social proof stack.
